engine_lineage.reason: The pinned AlVin command interface accepts diagonal forms. This host is a non-diagonal integral O_K lattice, and no O_K-unimodular diagonalization preserving its lattice was constructed.  Feeding only a K-diagonalization would change the enumerated integral lattice.  The bounded prefix therefore uses the repository's native exact two-place/Schur/DD engines.

enumeration.method: Exact two-place control boxes; z_i^2<=2T alphabet; A_d inverse Schur pruning for every prefix; exact A22 inverse reconstruction; basis reflection-integrality; chronological acute gate.

geometry.bounded_verdict: The complete H<=10 prefix cone is infinite-volume: it has 41 exact hyperideal extreme rays.  Later walls may cut them.

anisotropic.proof: A nonzero K-isotropic vector would remain isotropic after conjugation, contradicting positive definiteness at the second real embedding.

minimal_vinberg_field.proof: The two-cycle Cartan product A01*A10=c=2+2phi is nonrational, while all Cartan data lie in Q(sqrt(5)).

mirror_norms.proof: For a primitive reflective vector r put q=B(r,r) and I(r)=(B(r,L)).  At a prime P, adj(B)B(r)=det(B)r and primitivity give v_P(I(r))<=v_P(det(B)); q|2I(r) therefore gives v_P(q)<=v_P(2)+v_P(det(B)).  The exact factorization det(B)=-4(2+phi)(4+13phi) has valuations 2,1,1 at the inert prime (2), the ramified prime p5=(2+phi), and one split prime p101, and no other support.  Hence the possible exponents are respectively 0..3, 0..1, 0..1.  The conjugate form is positive definite, so every mirror norm is totally positive.  Since Z[phi] has class number one and every totally-positive unit is a square, unit-square normalization gives the displayed sixteen candidates.  Empty candidates are retained.
